catalogue.titre: Everything you need, in a single bot
catalogue.intro: Turn on only what you need. Every module is configured in a few clicks from the dashboard.

security.accroche: Keep your server healthy and under control.

community.accroche: Welcome, entertain and grow your community.

engagement.accroche: Reward activity and keep your members around.

utility.accroche: The tools that save time every day.

automod.description: Filters against spam, links, banned words and raids.

reports.description: Members report to the staff, with follow-up.

verification.description: Screens newcomers before they get access.

configbackup.description: Exports and restores the server configuration.

welcome.description: Customisable welcome messages and image cards.

tickets.description: Support in a channel or a private thread, archiving included.

reactionroles.description: Hands out roles through reactions or buttons.

interactivemessages.description: Reusable embeds with role buttons and links.

stickymessages.description: A message that always stays at the bottom of a channel.

autoroles.description: Roles on join and a role while in voice.

streamalerts.description: Twitch, YouTube, Reddit, RSS and Dealabs.

streamer.description: A panel to deafen yourself and stream a game without muting your mic.

levels.description: Message and voice XP, rank cards, leaderboard.

economy.description: Currency, shops, daily rewards, voice earnings.

giveaways.description: Button-entry contests with an automatic draw.

advent.description: One reward a day through December.

customcommands.description: Text or embed auto-replies with variables.

messageprofiles.description: Makes the bot speak under a name and an avatar.

reminders.description: Scheduled reminders for you or the server.

serverstats.description: Voice channels showing members, boosts, roles…

tempvoice.description: Join-to-create with a full management panel.

freegames.description: Announces Steam, Epic Games and GOG giveaways.

patchnotes.description: Follows update notes for games and software.

info.description: Member, server, role, avatar and emoji cards on demand.

music.description: Playback in voice channels (YouTube, Spotify…) through Lavalink.

games.description: Mini-games, statistics and item drops by rarity.

items.description: Inventory, items to collect, trade and win in game.

market.description: Player market: list your items, buy what others put up for sale.

route.description: Solo adventure: walk the road, face events, earn coins and items.

commandes.intro: The staff types nothing any more: everything is set up in a few clicks from the dashboard. Slash commands stay where they are actually useful — games, profile, music.

rang.texte: Your rank card and the server XP leaderboard.

solde.texte: Your balance and your daily reward.

inventaire.texte: Your items, to use, gift or resell.

hdv.texte: The marketplace: buy and sell between members.

route.texte: Set off on the Endless Road and face its events.

minijeux.texte: Mini-games, solo or against another member.

play.texte: Play music in your voice channel (search or link).

suggestion.texte: Submit an idea for the community to vote on.
